summary: Dividing Ridge lookout where Metcalfe, Adair and Cumberland counties meet; NHLR-registered 2022 as US 1592 and described as standing in a 2025 photo caption. Build date, height and history not found.

events.note: Registered May 22, 2022 as US 1592, KY 13; nominated by M Davis
Columbia Magazine photo caption (article posted 2025-07-27) says the tower stands; caption spells the name Renox

evidence.supports: sits at the intersection of Metcalfe, Adair and Cumberland counties atop Dividing Ridge
evidence.quote: This lookout sits at the intersection of Metcalfe, Adair, and Cumberland Counties atop Dividing Ridge.

evidence.supports: administered by the Kentucky Division of Forestry
caption: tower stands, with two legs in Metcalfe, one in Adair and one in Cumberland counties; spelled Renox
evidence.quote: Renox Fire Tower in the Breeding Community. It stands with two legs in Metcalfe County, one leg in Adair County and one leg in Cumberland County!

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Columbia Magazine caption spells it Renox; the National Historic Lookout Register spells it Rennox. The story uses Rennox, the register's spelling.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The register gives no build date, height, design, staffing or access, and the Columbia caption (July 2025) is the only evidence it still stands. The Forest Lookouts Kentucky list has only 'RENNOX, Metcalfe County' with no detail page. A Facebook 'Abandoned Kentucky' post about an abandoned Metcalfe County tower is not tied to this lookout, so it was not used. The Columbia 'Great Wooded South' series by Billy Joe Fudge may have another piece on this tower; worth checking. No photos recorded: the register and Columbia photo credits have no clear license.
